_comment: Realistic regression fixture modeled on the markdown_here submission: strict_min_version 115.0 while messages.tags.list was added in Thunderbird 121, but the call sits below a guard clause that returns when the API is absent. The guard signal makes it a judgement call, so strict-min-version-api emits NO finding here - the site goes to manual review instead (see the golden .txt). Contrast tests/addons/strict-min-version-api, whose identical call is unguarded and is rejected.
